inline.titleEn: Sun-Sign Snippet vs Full Birth Chart
inline.titleZh: 太阳星座速览与完整星盘对比
inline.altEn: Side-by-side comparison: what a Sun-sign snippet shows versus what a full birth chart reveals
inline.altZh: 对比图：太阳星座速览与完整星盘各自揭示的内容

linesEn: Uses only the Sun's zodiac position
Generalizes to everyone born that month
linesZh: 仅使用太阳所在星座位置
适用于同月出生的所有人
所有双鱼座贴同一标签

linesEn: Plots Moon, rising sign, and aspects
Reads uniquely for one person's life
Nuanced but requires a verified birth time
No two Pisces charts land the same
linesZh: 绘制月亮、上升星座及相位
针对个人生命的独特解读
细腻深入，需要准确出生时间
没有两张双鱼座星盘完全相同

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read a Birth Chart as a Character Study
inline.titleEn: 5 Signals to Look for in Coco Gauff's Chart
inline.titleZh: 解读科科·高夫星盘的5个关键信号
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for reading a birth chart as a character study using Coco Gauff's placements
inline.altZh: 以科科·高夫星盘为例，将星盘作为性格研究解读的五步流程

items.nameEn: Pisces Sun in a Pressure Sport
items.nameZh: 压力运动中的双鱼太阳
items.subEn: Notice emotional expressiveness and imagination — water-sign sensitivity read as feel, not softness
items.subZh: 观察情感表达与想象力——水象星座的敏感性体现为感知力，而非软弱

items.subEn: Watch how she resets after a lost set; weigh against Moon and rising-sign themes about emotional reflexes
items.subZh: 观察她在输掉一盘后如何调整状态；结合月亮与上升星座对情绪反射的诠释

items.subEn: Track how directly she speaks up in interviews — a natural place to look for Mercury placements
items.subZh: 观察她在采访中发言的直接程度——这是探寻水星位置的天然窗口

items.subEn: Pisces is linked to flow and improvisation; look for feel-based play rather than mechanical patterns
items.subZh: 双鱼座与流动性和即兴发挥相关；寻找感知型打法而非机械化模式

items.subEn: Where birth time is uncertain, treat any rising-sign claim as a hypothesis to test, never a stated fact
items.subZh: 出生时间不确定时，任何上升星座说法都应视为待验证的假设，而非既定事实
